name: RotSprite 45-degree rotation preserves outline contours and color boundaries
description: Rotating a circular sprite with a dark outline and light interior by 45 degrees preserves the exterior contour without dark blotches inside or outline breaks.

planSteps.description: Select the ellipse tool in the left toolbar
Choose a light cyan color and enable filled shape
Draw a centered filled circle leaving generous margin from canvas edges
Choose a dark navy outline color and disable filled shape
Draw a concentric circular border surrounding the light cyan circle
Open the PixiTools inspector in the right sidebar
Expand the Pixel Cleanup & RotSprite section
Set the rotation angle slider to 45 degrees
Verify the rotated silhouette maintains a solid dark perimeter around the light cyan interior
Verify no stray dark pixels appear inside the cyan fill and no cyan pixels breach the outer margin
